- `htm-preact-standalone.umd.js`: htm 3.1.1 with Preact (MIT), from
  `https://unpkg.com/htm@3.1.1/preact/standalone.umd.js`, unmodified.
  SHA-384 `w94Y7k7ToXbmIx5Vi/LxHtprASwddoLhbR/0ZhekgNn8pP9VNRRHzmp2tqrALfKY`
  (the same file the Phase 9 mockup loads). Exposes `window.htmPreact`.

Fonts live in `../fonts/`: Inter, JetBrains Mono, Plus Jakarta Sans (OFL, via
@fontsource) and a Noto Sans SC subset (OFL, see `NotoSansSC-OFL.txt`).
